mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month indicates an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL YoY change above 3.5% signals aggressive tightening amid persistent inflation, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC for HOUST decline falls below 0.03 in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.1pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signal weak residential demand, reducing construction sector activity and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market tightness that may trigger inflationary pressures and rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced supply chain efficiency and lower corporate output, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines during manufacturing slowdown, or Rank IC for INDPRO decline falls below 0.03 in that regime.
